sample_retrieval_traces.title: Organic Protein Meal Shake Daily Routine
Apex SUV Safety & Comfort Non-Skippable Ad

issues.description: The ad does not prominently disclose the material connection with the sponsor before the consumer makes a purchasing decision.
issues.remediation: Disclose the sponsorship at the beginning of the ad, e.g., 'Thanks to the sponsor for sending this over.'

issues.description: The ad makes unproven and exaggerated claims about the product's efficacy, such as 'clinically proven to permanently reverse cellular aging' and '100% CURE FOR WRINKLES IN 48 HOURS'.
issues.remediation: Provide evidence of clinical trials or substantiate the claims with credible scientific data.

issues.description: The ad duration exceeds the 6.0 seconds maximum allowed by YouTube's bumper ad specifications.
issues.remediation: Reduce the ad duration to 6.0 seconds or less.

issues.description: The disclosure of the material connection is placed at the end of the ad, which is not in compliance with the requirement to place it prominently with the endorsement itself.
issues.remediation: Place the disclosure at the beginning of the ad, e.g., 'Thanks to the sponsor for sending this over.'

issues.description: The disclosure of the material connection is placed at the end of the ad, which is not in compliance with the requirement to place it prominently with the endorsement itself.
issues.remediation: Place the disclosure at the beginning of the ad, e.g., 'Thanks to the sponsor for sending this over.'

issues.description: The text overlay 'Link in bio for 20% off' is placed in the bottom right corner, which may clash with the bottom-left ad badge and is not legible on smartphone screens.
issues.remediation: Move the text overlay to a more prominent and legible location, e.g., the top center or middle center.

issues.description: The disclosure is placed at the end of the video, which is prohibited. It should be placed prominently with the endorsement itself.
issues.remediation: Place the disclosure at the beginning or during the review, not at the end.

issues.description: The influencer did not disclose the financial tie with the brand, which is required.
issues.remediation: Clearly disclose the sponsorship at the beginning of the video.

issues.description: The ad makes a scientific claim that the product 'clinically proven to permanently reverse cellular aging and eliminate all forehead wrinkles in 48 hours without any clinical trials or diet changes' without rigorous proof.
issues.remediation: Provide evidence of clinical trials or other rigorous proof supporting the claims.

issues.description: The ad makes a medical claim that the product 'completely cures dermal senescence' without rigorous proof.
issues.remediation: Provide evidence of medical studies or other rigorous proof supporting the claims.

issues.description: The ad duration is 42 seconds, which is longer than the recommended 15-20 seconds.
issues.remediation: Consider shortening the ad to 15-20 seconds to comply with the recommended duration.

issues.description: The on-screen text uses the term '100% CURE FOR WRINKLES IN 48 HOURS', which is a prohibited term and should be replaced with an approved term.
issues.remediation: Replace the term with an approved term such as '#ad' or 'advertisement'.

issues.description: The video duration exceeds the 6.0 seconds maximum allowed for non-skippable YouTube Bumper Ads.
issues.remediation: Shorten the video to 6.0 seconds or less.

issues.description: The #ad tag is not visible within the first 5 seconds, as required by the FTC guidelines.
issues.remediation: Ensure the #ad tag is visible within the first 5 seconds of the video.

issues.description: The on-screen text 'Tap Shop button below' does not comply with the CTA requirements, as it exceeds the 10-character limit.
issues.remediation: Shorten the CTA to 10 characters or less.

issues.description: The on-screen text 'CLEAN ENERGY THAT LASTS' and 'ZERO CRASH - ZERO SUGAR' do not have high visual contrast against the moving video background.
issues.remediation: Ensure the text has high visual contrast against the background.

issues.description: The ad duration is 28 seconds, which exceeds the maximum allowed duration of 60 seconds.
issues.remediation: Reduce the ad duration to within the 10-60 second range, ideally 10-30 seconds.

issues.description: The text overlay 'Tap Shop button below' is placed in the bottom 20% of the video, which is a safe zone and should be avoided.
issues.remediation: Move the text overlay to a non-safe zone, ensuring it does not cover the bottom 20% of the video.

issues.description: The ad contains a claim that the product 'GlowUp' provides a 'zero crash' effect, which may be a health claim without rigorous proof.
issues.remediation: Ensure the claim is substantiated by personal experience or scientific evidence, or remove the claim if not supported.

issues.description: The ad duration of 7.8 seconds exceeds the maximum allowed duration of 7 seconds for non-skippable in-stream ads.
issues.remediation: Reduce the ad duration to 7 seconds or less.

issues.description: The text 'AVAILABLE AT BEST BUY' appears in the bottom 20% of the screen, which is a critical safe zone and may be covered by the ad badge.
issues.remediation: Move the text to a non-critical safe zone, such as the top 85% of the screen.

issues.description: The ad duration is 7.8 seconds, which exceeds the 6.0-second maximum limit for YouTube Bumper Ads.
issues.remediation: Reduce the ad duration to 6.0 seconds or less.

issues.description: The ad duration is 7.8 seconds, which exceeds the 15-second maximum limit for Non-Skippable In-Stream Ads.
issues.remediation: Reduce the ad duration to 15 seconds or less.

issues.description: The ad does not include a disclosure that it is sponsored content. The disclosure is only present in the video description and not in the video itself.
issues.remediation: Ensure the disclosure 'Sponsored' or similar is visible in the video content, both in spoken audio and on-screen text.

issues.description: The disclosure is placed at the beginning of the video, but the scientific claim is made after the disclosure, which could mislead viewers.
issues.remediation: Ensure all claims are made before the disclosure.

issues.description: The influencer claims a 92% success rate based on a consumer perception study, which is a scientific claim without rigorous proof.
issues.remediation: Provide evidence of the study or remove the claim.

issues.description: The influencer does not disclose the financial partnership with GlowSkin in the on-screen text, which is required.
issues.remediation: Add '#ad Paid partnership with GlowSkin' to the on-screen text.

issues.description: The on-screen text uses 'GLOWSKIN CLINICAL HYDRATING CLEANSER' without the approved hashtag '#ad'.
issues.remediation: Replace 'GLOWSKIN CLINICAL HYDRATING CLEANSER' with '#ad GLOWSKIN CLINICAL HYDRATING CLEANSER'.

issues.category: YouTube Shorts Ads & Vertical Safe Zones
issues.description: The call-to-action 'Shop Now' is placed in the right 15% edge, which is a safe zone and could be obscured by the Like/Comment icons.
issues.remediation: Move the call-to-action to a non-safe zone, such as the middle of the screen.

issues.description: The disclosure is not placed prominently with the endorsement itself. The #ad banner is placed 2 seconds after the spoken disclosure.
issues.remediation: Ensure the #ad disclosure is placed immediately after the spoken disclosure.

issues.description: The scientific claim is not substantiated by competent and rigorous proof. The claim of 92% reported smoother skin is based on a consumer perception study, which may not be rigorous enough.
issues.remediation: Provide evidence of rigorous scientific studies or clinical trials supporting the claim.

issues.description: The hashtag #ad is used, but it is not immediately followed by the full disclosure. The full disclosure is only visible after the spoken #ad.
issues.remediation: Ensure the full disclosure is visible immediately after the spoken #ad.

issues.description: The disclosure is placed only at the very end of the video, which is prohibited. The disclosure should be placed prominently with the endorsement itself.
issues.remediation: Place the #ad disclosure immediately after the spoken #ad.

issues.description: The video duration is 45 seconds, which is longer than the recommended 15-20 seconds.
issues.remediation: Consider shortening the video to the recommended duration.

issues.description: The CTA 'Shop Now' is 8 characters, which is within the limit but may be too short for clarity. It is also placed in the upper-right safe zone, which is acceptable.
issues.remediation: Ensure the CTA is clear and consider adding more descriptive text if necessary.

issues.description: The disclosure is placed at the end of the video, after the claims are made.
issues.remediation: Place the disclosure at the beginning of the video, before any claims are made.

issues.description: The creator does not disclose the financial tie with the brand until the end of the video.
issues.remediation: Disclose the financial tie immediately after the 'Guys, I was paid to talk about this' statement.

issues.description: The hashtag #ad is used, but it is not prominently displayed and is buried in the text.
issues.remediation: Ensure the hashtag #ad is prominently displayed and not buried in the text.

issues.description: The claim of a 500% monthly return with zero risk is made without personal experience or scientific substantiation.
issues.remediation: Provide personal experience or scientific substantiation for the claims made.

issues.description: The video duration is 50.0 seconds, which exceeds the 6.0 seconds hard limit.
issues.remediation: Reduce the video duration to 6.0 seconds or less.

issues.description: The disclosure is not placed prominently with the endorsement itself. It appears after the creator has made claims about the product's performance.
issues.remediation: Place the disclosure immediately after the first mention of the product and before any claims about its performance.

issues.description: The disclosure is not placed before consumers make purchasing decisions. The creator makes claims about the product's performance before the disclosure.
issues.remediation: Ensure the disclosure is placed before any claims about the product's performance.

issues.description: The creator makes a scientific claim about the product's performance (500% monthly return with zero risk) without personal experience or scientific substantiation.
issues.remediation: Provide personal experience or scientific substantiation for the claims made about the product's performance.

issues.description: The creator has a financial tie with the brand but does not disclose this relationship.
issues.remediation: Clearly disclose the financial tie with the brand at the beginning of the video.

issues.description: The on-screen text 'CRYPTOYIELD AI TRADING BOT' does not match the approved disclosure term '#ad'.
issues.remediation: Replace 'CRYPTOYIELD AI TRADING BOT' with '#ad' or 'advertisement' to comply with approved terminology.
